name: Fujishima Ayame
source:
Stepmother of the protagonist. Half-Japanese.
Regarded as a flawless superwoman, this capable woman became the chief of the Fujishima family.
Following a philosophy of "If one does not work, neither shall he eat", she's very harsh towards people perceived as useless, even inside the household.
